exceptions.reason: Taro 4.2 pins webpack-dev-server 4.x; it is used only by local development tooling and is not present in the deployed miniapp runtime.
exceptions.compensatingControl: CI builds immutable artifacts without exposing a dev server; developer servers bind to trusted workstations only.

exceptions.reason: Taro 4.2 pins webpack 5.91; the affected browser DOM public-path gadget is not available in the WeChat miniapp runtime.
exceptions.compensatingControl: Miniapp assets are built with a fixed platform target and cannot consume attacker-controlled DOM elements or currentScript values.

exceptions.reason: The vulnerable proxy router is a transitive Taro development dependency and no host-plus-path proxy table is configured.
exceptions.compensatingControl: Production contains only compiled miniapp assets; local dev proxies are not exposed to untrusted networks.

exceptions.reason: Taro helper pins the affected build-time esbuild; the vulnerable serve mode is not used by release or production commands.
exceptions.compensatingControl: CI invokes bounded build commands only and never exposes esbuild serve endpoints.

exceptions.reason: Taro 4.2 pins webpack-dev-server 4.x; the affected development endpoint is not deployed.
exceptions.compensatingControl: Development servers are local-only and production artifacts contain no webpack-dev-server process.

exceptions.reason: Taro 4.2 pins webpack-dev-server 4.x; source-serving WebSocket behavior is development-only.
exceptions.compensatingControl: No remote development server is permitted; CI artifacts are generated in isolated runners.

exceptions.reason: The affected HMR proxy interception path is not configured and is absent from production runtime.
exceptions.compensatingControl: No broad WebSocket proxy is configured; development servers remain local-only.

exceptions.reason: The affected qs version is reachable only through Taro's webpack development server and its non-default comma stringify mode is not used.
exceptions.compensatingControl: Production backend uses the patched NestJS dependency chain; Taro development endpoints are not exposed.

exceptions.reason: The affected UUID implementation is nested under sockjs in Taro's development server and is not shipped as application identity logic.
exceptions.compensatingControl: Production identifiers are generated by backend database/application code; no webpack development server runs in production.
